description: Change a model you have: retexture (new PBR textures from a picture or words; trellis-2-texture 5, trellis-2-texture-pro 10, tripo-texture 20, tripo-texture-detailed 40, meshy-texture 50 credits) or remesh (new, clean topology at a face count; tripo-remesh 50 credits). The mesh is an https URL, an upload id from upload_file, a library id (ph:wooden_barrel_01) or a job id, so steps chain without downloading. Waits about 45 s, then returns job_id for get_job. To reduce, compress, convert or repair a file, use gltf-transform or Blender locally.

image.description: retexture: the look as a picture.

mesh.description: The model: URL, upl_..., library id, or job_...

model.description: retexture or remesh: the model to use.

options.description: remesh: faces (500 to 20,000; 10,000 as quads), topology (quads|triangles).

prompt.description: retexture: the look in words, when there is no picture.

name: edit_model
title: Edit a 3D model
